findings.message: The ticket requires running pytest in a temporary project, but the integration guard blocks file writes and subprocesses for the required new test file. The file is outside the scope fence, and the implementer instructions permit real I/O only for tests of real I/O functions.
findings.paved_road: Reconcile the real-pytest acceptance criterion with the integration I/O policy and fence the required test infrastructure changes, or replace it with an in-memory integration criterion.

findings.message: Criterion 5 requires the existing fail-closed and capture cases to pass unchanged, but this file is currently skipped by the integration setup because it uses real disk and git; removing the skip alone would expose it to the I/O guard.
findings.paved_road: Re-scope the ticket to migrate the required cases to the supported in-memory seams, including the integration setup change, or revise the acceptance criterion.
